geometries.method: Midpoint of the observed 13.5–14.8°W Portugal Current crossing at 37°N in October–November 2009; not a full path.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The 2009 study identifies one zonal crossing at 37°N; its 13.5–14.8°W longitude band and transport do not establish a whole-current length. Keep the offshore Portugal Current distinct from coastal counterflows.

named_current_source_observations.spatial_basis: The paper reports the Portugal Current between 14.8°W and 13.5°W along its 37°N section. This is a cross-stream band, not an along-current trace.
named_current_source_observations.state_boundary_limit: The reported cross-stream band intersects the approximate NAST E polygon; the state boundary and observed current extent are not surveyed together.
named_current_source_observations.time_detail: The dates bound the entire ORCA cruise; the exact occupation dates of this current band are not separately assigned here.
